title: EU AI Act obligation
description: One row per distinct obligation, prohibition, right or institutional duty in Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, coded from the article text in data/articles.jsonl. The quote is the Regulation's words; everything else is SafeLegalAI's coding and says so.

obligation_id.description: art-<article>-<paragraph>[-<point>][-<n>] e.g. art-26-6, art-5-1-a, art-4-0 for unnumbered

article.description: article number; string for inserted articles such as "4a", "75a"

summary.description: one or two sentences, SafeLegalAI's plain-English coding of what must (not) be done, by whom, when — no advice

quote.description: the operative words of the Regulation, verbatim, ≤ 60 words, in quotation marks

applies_from.description: date the obligation applies, from Article 113 as amended by any act in force on the research date

applies_from_basis.description: e.g. 'Art. 113(a)' · 'Art. 113 second subparagraph (general application)' · 'Art. 113(c)' · '<amending regulation> Art. N' when a later act changed the date

transitional_note.description: Art. 111 grandfathering or other transitional treatment, if any

penalty_basis.description: 'Art. 99(3)' (prohibitions, up to €35m/7%), 'Art. 99(4)' (most operator obligations, €15m/3%), 'Art. 99(5)' (incorrect information, €7.5m/1%), 'Art. 101' (GPAI providers), or null

legal_practice_relevance.description: how directly this bites a law firm, chambers, in-house team or court that deploys AI, or a legal-AI vendor as provider

legal_practice_note.description: descriptive only: which legal-practice actor it reaches and why (e.g. 'a firm using a high-risk system is a deployer'); never 'you should'

cross_references.description: articles/annexes/recitals this row depends on, e.g. ['Art. 6', 'Annex III', 'Recital 61']

applies_from_as_enacted.description: the date under Article 113 as enacted in 2024, before Regulation (EU) 2026/1744

text_amended_since_coding.description: true when the article text was amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 after this row was first coded from the enacted text; such rows are re-coded from the consolidated text

coded_from.description: which text the quote and coding were taken from
